{{Top|leg}}
The '''Tinuvian tar pits''' were a natural phenomenon, situated on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Tinuvia system/Legends|Tinuvia system]]. They were a subject of a popular phrase, "as if he/she had been dragged through a Tinuvian tar pit", referring to their currently bedraggled state.<ref name="VP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Tinuvian tar pits were created by author [[R. A. Salvatore]] for his [[1999]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]'', in which they receive a brief mention.
